annotations.title: CAGR, IRR and XIRR Investment Return Calculator

description: Computes Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR), timing-exact XIRR / IRR via Newton-Raphson across follow-on checks and interim distributions, Gross and Net MOIC, DPI, and Net LP XIRR after VC carry. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/cagr-irr-xirr-calculator.

carry_pct.description: Carried interest percent on positive net profit. Default 20.

exit_value_usd.description: Final exit proceeds or current NAV USD. Default 750000.

follow_on_year.description: Years from start when follow-on occurs. Default 1.5.

hold_years.description: Total holding period in years. Default 5.

interim_distribution_usd.description: Optional interim cash or secondary payout USD. Default 0.

interim_year.description: Years from start when interim distribution occurs. Default 3.

name: calc_cagr_irr_xirr
title: CAGR, IRR and XIRR Investment Return Calculator
